representation.mesh_asset_id: external stable asset reference; mesh bytes are not stored in this JSON state

identity_policy: Object IDs are stable across observations; observations never create a new identity implicitly.

fusion_policy.conflicts: logged and rejected, never silently overwritten
fusion_policy.stale_observations: rejected when observation step is older than world step

caveat: Confidence fusion is a transparent toy rule, not a calibrated Bayesian estimator or learned multi-agent system. Thresholds are synthetic defaults and require empirical calibration.
